description:
The investigator (backend/investigator) on the Skeptic's fault-injection clips
(evaluation/experiments/skeptic_faults.py: same scenes, same faults, same
cached renders).

Question: when the Skeptic blocks a reconstruction, does the investigator
recover a CORRECT answer, and does it ever turn a refusal into a wrong one?

Per clip, for the base pipeline and for the investigator's final case:
  answered     speeds reported and no blocking dispute / rejection
  worst error  largest |relative speed error| of a reported (non-withheld) speed
  covered      every reported speed's 90 % interval contains the true speed
  harmful      answered, no flag, and worst error > 10 %

  python3 investigator_faults.py --n 8   -> evaluation/results/investigator_faults.json

requests.why: every speed scales with the frame rate; 30.0 fps comes from the file's metadata, which is often wrong. Confirm it if you know the camera's rate

trace.diagnosis: temporal_stability: the geometry of the two halves of the clip disagrees, so a single road geometry cannot be right for the whole clip
trace.action: measure the background's displacement through the clip and look for one abrupt shift
trace.observation: too few background features to measure camera motion
trace.decision: no single camera bump found: the dispute stands

trace.action: quarantine the measurements of the subject vehicle(s) in the frames where the motion is impossible (treat them as unmeasured) and re-run the reasoning on the rest
